decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service moved from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits the firm's established offer in a growing industry with ample slack.

The open GIS framework is core to the firm's open, extensible component strategy, so a medium firm with R&D and slack would keep carrying it, although its visibility stayed at a mention and did not grow.

The identity service for GIS applications was actively promoted with a launch message and gained its own page in 2024, which points to satisfactory performance and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, needs few resources, and builds on existing consulting know-how, so the firm can easily carry it while its results are still uncertain.
